Thanks again for the call earlier, Samir — good discussion. Quick recap + proposed next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML and infra engineers so we can walk through a short architecture sketch, run a quick cost/latency estimate based on your throughput profile, and sketch a rollout plan for a POC.

Ask: can you confirm a 60–90 minute slot next week and the list of internal NexaBio attendees (data owners, infra, security)? I attached a short prep checklist (Nexa_TDX_Prep_Checklist.pdf) that makes the session productive.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 2025-10-28 9:30–11:00 PT
- Wed 2025-10-29 13:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 2025-10-31 10:00–11:30 PT

If none work, send 3 slots that suit your team and we’ll lock one. Suggested internal Redwood attendees I’ll bring: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) and Connor O'Brien (Infra/Serving lead).

Proposed agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m — goal alignment & success metrics for POC
2) 25–40m — infra + model performance discussion (KV cache, batching, quantization, expected latencies)
3) 15–25m — demo/ops runbook and rollout plan (routing, fallback, monitoring)
4) 10–15m — open Q&A / next steps / action items

I’ll also add a HubSpot note and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks,
